title: How The Caesars Entertainment (CZR) Story Is Shifting With Takeover Talk And New Valuation Targets
title_zh: 凯撒娱乐 (CZR) 的故事如何随着收购传闻和新的估值目标而发生变化
summary: Caesars Entertainment is back in focus as analysts refresh their models and tweak price targets, with some firms lifting targets by US$1 to US$7 while others trim them, including a move to US$25 from US$27 at Morgan Stanley.
summary_zh: 随着分析师更新模型并调整价格目标，凯撒娱乐重新成为焦点，一些公司将目标价格上调 1 美元至 7 美元，而另一些公司则下调价格，其中摩根士丹利将目标价格从 27 美元调至 25 美元。

title: Google-backed stock jumps after new AI deal
title_zh: 新的人工智能交易后谷歌支持的股票上涨
summary: Shares of TeraWulf (Nasdaq: WULF) surged during market hours on May 26 after the Bitcoin miner-turned-AI infrastructure company announced the acquisition of a hyperscale high-performance computing site.
summary_zh: TeraWulf（纳斯达克股票代码：WULF）的股价在 5 月 26 日市场交易时段飙升，此前这家由比特币矿工转型为人工智能基础设施的公司宣布收购一家超大规模高性能计算网站。

title: Goldman Sachs 1MDB Deal Clarifies Settlement Costs And Valuation Picture
title_zh: 高盛 1MDB 交易澄清了和解成本和估值情况
summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS) has agreed to a US$500 million settlement to resolve a 1MDB related shareholder class-action lawsuit. The case alleged that the bank misled investors about its role in the Malaysian 1MDB bond deals tied to corruption allegations.
summary_zh: 高盛集团（纽约证券交易所股票代码：GS）已同意支付 5 亿美元和解金，以解决 1MDB 相关股东集体诉讼。该案指控该银行在与腐败指控相关的马来西亚 1MDB 债券交易中的角色误导了投资者。

title: Private Credit Really Is More Than Loans to Leveraged Buyouts
title_zh: 私人信贷实际上不仅仅是杠杆收购贷款
summary: Investors are worried about loans that private-credit funds have made to fund buyouts., but the funds do a lot more than that.
summary_zh: 投资者担心私人信贷基金为收购提供的贷款，但这些基金的作用远不止于此。
